max_event_bytes_status: project proposal only; not an agreed transport limit

reference_model.kind: test-only in-memory oracle; not an implemented restore or delivery mechanism
reference_model.deduplicate_by: event_id; conflicting reuse is rejected for learning events and deletion markers
reference_model.equal_occurred_at_tie_break: lexicographically greatest event_id within the same subject/course/lesson/type projection
reference_model.restore_order: apply durable tombstones before replaying snapshot events; fail closed if completeness is unknown or incomplete
reference_model.deleted_subject: suppress its personal and shared contributions, including late events; new registration requires a new subject_ref and new event_id
reference_model.synthetic_aggregate: recalculate test event counts from surviving contributions; not an implemented Analytics aggregate

notes: subject_ref is an opaque random UUID, not an account or session identifier
course_id and lesson_id are exact stable IDs from the current local catalog; task_id is null for lesson-level examples
Only allowlisted fields and catalog-bound identities are accepted
synthetic is a test-fixture-only payload marker, not a proposed or approved production payload field; lesson events are synthetic examples and do not claim existing Core event sources
This fixture defines no delivery mechanism or implemented restoration process
Deletion marker is durable input to this reference model and tombstones all personal and shared contributions for its subject
